artifact.name: Trait Reputation UE5 Implementation Readiness Contract V1

rules: Canonical IDs are FName-compatible stable tokens.
Registry load fails on duplicate, malformed, deprecated, or unknown mandatory IDs.
Trait instance references one CharacterId and one TraitId.
Reputation key requires SubjectCharacterId, AudienceId or AudienceKindId, and ReputationDimensionId.
Trait is not destiny. Reputation is not fact.
Mutable outcomes never live in definition assets.

ownership.historical_memory_boundary: Historical Memory owns facts, evidence, narratives, reception history, commemoration, preservation, and legacy.
ownership.presentation_boundary: UI derives labels and epithets from authorized read models only.
ownership.ai_boundary: AI reads state, evaluates alternatives, explains reasons, and proposes commands. AI never mutates authoritative state directly.

validation: Owner validates IDs, authority, evidence, chronology, visibility, audience scope, and invariants before commit.
Events are emitted only after successful owner commit.
Command order uses stable canonical sorting.

registry_loading.source_format: Authoritative JSON may be imported into UE-native data during build/editor preparation.
recommended_assets: UPrimaryDataAsset-derived registry asset or cooked immutable registry table
Generated canonical-ID constants only when generation is deterministic and registry-derived
prohibited: Deprecated IDs in new content or saves

rules: Opening States never overwrite advanced saves.
Source save remains unchanged during migration.
Load then save then reload preserves normalized authoritative state.

performance: Use indexed lookup by canonical ID.
Keep lightweight characters definition-reference only unless activated.
Batch validation and migration offline or headless.

required_validation_fixtures.expected: Fail safely or quarantine by contract

required_validation_fixtures.case: Acquire and remove Trait through commands
Same subject and dimension across two audiences
Reputation without evidence or information path

implementation_sequence: Add typed IDs and immutable definition structs.
Add registry loader and validator using committed registries.
Add owner subsystems and read-only query interfaces.
Add validated command and event paths.
Add runtime state structs with audience-specific Reputation keys.
Add versioned save schema and quarantine records.
Add headless fixtures and deterministic normalized hashes.
Run controlled runtime and save fixtures.
smallest_useful_next_action: Create the UE5 typed-ID and immutable registry-loader implementation first, with tests TR-FX-001 through TR-FX-004. Do not begin mutable Trait/Reputation runtime behavior until registry loading and validation compile successfully.
